ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio approximately 70:30 low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white) pixels. Brightness is concentrated at the distal tips of the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs located at both distal tips. The right lobe distal region contains a larger, more irregular white patch with dark focal spots. The left lobe distal region contains a smaller, cleaner white patch. The central fluke body consists of a solid low-intensity dark mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 135 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe distal edge displays deep, high-amplitude valleys. Left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, more regular peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve on the leading edges tapering to sharp points at the distal ends; trailing edge follows a generally linear trajectory interrupted by serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, scattered high-intensity circular pixel clusters visible on the dark pigment of the inner left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, multi-directional linear white marks (rake marks) concentrated on the right lobe, cutting through the dark pigment area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel linear rake marks on the right lobe and significant irregular notch-like tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'hook' shape at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe combined with dense white scarring.
